category_title: Students with autism displaying sensory-seeking vocalizations
minimal_context: The student is gathered on the floor with the whole class for a circle time activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, please sit on the floor so we can begin our circle time activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits on the floor but begins making humming and mouth noises.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Rick, please stop making those noises.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks up, smiles, and continues making the mouth noises.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stop; otherwise you will have to leave.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes clearly agitated, continues the noises, and pulls away) Noooo!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, please sit on the floor so we can begin our circle time activity.

STUDENT: (Sits on the floor but begins making humming and mouth noises.)

TUTOR: Rick, please stop making those noises.

STUDENT: (Looks up, smiles, and continues making the mouth noises.)

TUTOR: You need to stop; otherwise you will have to leave.

STUDENT: (Becomes clearly agitated, continues the noises, and pulls away) Noooo!

task.content: Circle time activity with the whole class gathered on the floor.

context.materials: Card with a picture of a boy with the hands over his lips and the word 'quiet' below it
context.social_setting: Whole class gathered on the floor for circle time

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When Ms Nelson told him he would 'have to leave'

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked to stop making noises with his mouth
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: He looks at me and smiles. He did not stop and was dragged by the arms outside of the classroom, saying 'Noooo'.
